name: pi-extensions
description: Extensions for the Pi coding agent

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "throw new Error('This package is not published to npm')"
scripts.pretest: npm ci --prefix extensions/google-calendar --ignore-scripts --no-audit && npm ci --prefix extensions/fastmail-contact-groups --ignore-scripts --no-audit
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:extensions && npm run check:calendar && npm run check:fastmail-contact-groups
